result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with clean spacing, consistent card structure, and a clear bottom navigation bar. The main visual defect is a missing restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, which shows a broken-image placeholder. A minor contrast issue also affects the favorite button on that card. Clipped carousel items and cut-off cards at the viewport edges were excluded as intentional.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken-image placeholder icon on a flat grey background instead of a food photo, making the most prominent listing look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL resolves, add a fallback food image or branded placeholder, and handle image load errors gracefully.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is a semi-transparent grey circle with a white icon over a light grey image area, so its contrast is weak and it is hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque or darker button background, or add a subtle shadow or border so the favorite control stands out on light backgrounds.
